plans.idea: Keep the original's two-column split adapted to a square: headline, subhead and button stacked on one left edge, with the book large on the right, vertically centred on the text block.
A diagonal Z-path: a big headline block across the top-left leads down to the book in the lower right, and the button and fine print anchor the lower-left so weight balances across the square.
A centred poster stack on one vertical axis: the book on top as the visual hook, then the '2 for 1' offer and subhead, then the button, with the fine print set small at the foot.
